title: Dainty
text: Dainty. This  tea cup and saucer set are adorable and I like the spoon it came with.

product_metadata.title: Porlien Twinkling All-over Star Exquisite Porcelain Teacups/Coffee Cups & Saucers Sets of 4 with Spoons-6.7Oz, Gold Trimmed Royal Blue
features: FANTASY & CHILDHOOD AWAKE: Stars interweaving with gold lines all over on the cup and saucer set easily brings you back to the days when you were a child. Remember? Twinkle, twinkle, little stars...How I wonder what you are!
UPSCALE: The royal blue color and gold together give the coffee cup and saucer set a feeling of daintiness and luxury, which could add shine and elegance to your coffee or tea parties.
PERFECT FOR GIFT: Made of sturdy hardboard, the royal blue gift box brings the cup set up a notch, enabling it to be a class and perfect gift for your lovely friends who adore tea parties.

LIGHT BUT STURDY: The teacup set is relatively light but sturdy, enabling you to hold the teacup comfortably rather than clumsily. Specially designed styrofoam in the gift box can better ensures intactness of the teacup and saucer set.
